calls.title: GrowthBook & Zurich Demo
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the team's exploration of GrowthBook to enhance experimentation tools, potentially replacing some functionalities of Adobe Target for direct-to-consumer digital channels. Mary emphasized the need for robust tools for funnel-wide testing, while Ping highlighted technical challenges with dynamic content testing within Adobe Target. Tong stressed the importance of granular data and in-depth analysis for better insights. James clarified GrowthBook's architecture, indicating secure data handling within Snowflake, and the team's shared goal of engaging engineering for integration feasibility was echoed throughout the meeting. The overall conversation laid the groundwork for considering GrowthBook as a viable platform focused on scalability and governance.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, Feature Flagging, Multi-Arm Bandit, Snowflake integration, Dynamic Content, Holdouts
